incident-bot: ALERT: high error-rate - /v1/generate - 7xx spikes across us-west clusters. pager triggered (PD: #oncall)
jessica (oncall): seeing lots of 503/504s in logs. rolling consumer timeouts. investigating.
omar (sre): on it. initial check: edge LB healthy, spike correlates with deploy around 02:12 UTC? can someone confirm deploys?
kevin (runtime): no deploys at that time from runtime. we had heavier batching experiment enabling on node pool next-gen yesterday night, but toggle was off for prod.
lee (support): customer ticket thread: multiple enterprise customers reporting timeouts ~02:15->02:32, some saw degraded throughput.
jessica (oncall): temporary mitigation: scaling up pods + increasing retry backoff. pushing a squelch on noisy alert group.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: On-call assigned to jessica (oncall). Escalation policy: standard 15m.
omar (sre): quick hypothesis: a misbehaving model variant produced long tail latency, which pushed queueing causing upstream 504s. check model variants and QPS routing.
kevin (runtime): looking at request traces: heavy tails on model-variant redwood-opt-13b-q4 leading to increased token generation times. KV cache hit rate dropped for a handful of hosts.
jessica (oncall): manual routing change: divert traffic from redwood-opt-13b-q4 to redwood-opt-13b-q2 (compatible) for customers on hosted tier. applied at 02:24 UTC. monitoring.
omar (sre): good. taking note for postmortem. immediate asks: 1) reduce alert noise so PD only pages for customer-impacting surges, 2) tune grouping/dedupe to avoid flood on identical symptoms, 3) add a dashboard panel showing prefix of KV cache hit rates and model-variant latencies.
kevin (runtime): agree. current alerts fire on >5% 5xx per minute per service, but noise is high because many services report the same root cause. propose grouping keys: cluster + route + model_variant. also add a 1-minute dedupe window for duplicate traces.
omar (sre): propose concrete alert rule change (prom-style):

```
alert: HighService5xx
expr: sum by(cluster,route,model_variant) (rate(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum by(cluster,route,model_variant) (rate(http_requests_total[1m])) > 0.05
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "{{ $labels.cluster }} {{ $labels.route }} {{ $labels.model_variant }} high 5xx rate"
```
And then in Alertmanager set grouping_key: "{{ cluster }}|{{ route }}|{{ model_variant }}" and add a dedupe: 60s.
jessica (oncall): recommend interim change: raise for: to 2m and add grouping by model_variant. can we roll that now? want to avoid missing real incidents though.
omar (sre): we can patch to change `for: 1m -> 2m` and add grouping key in alertmanager. I'll open a fast PR and pin to staging then prod after 10m smoke.
kevin (runtime): also suggest suppressing alerts for known transient spikes using a rate_limit filter in alertmanager: `repeat_interval: 10m` for low-severity; keep page severity for >10% sustained across 3m.
lee (support): from customer side, add a short note in status page: "Degraded performance affecting generation latency for some customers in us-west. Mitigation in progress." helps reduce inbound tickets and duplicated PD noise.
pd-bot: PD note: Sweeping dedupe enabled for the ongoing incident. Reminder: do not auto-escalate until incident cleared.
omar (sre): follow-ups for post-incident: 1) create dashboard tile showing model_variant latency p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit ratio per host; 2) add runbook step: auto-fallback routing to compatible variant if model_variant latency > 95th for >2m; 3) implement alertmanager grouping and short dedupe window.
jessica (oncall): logging action items here so they persist:
- patch alert rule: add `model_variant` to grouping and `for: 2m` (omar will PR)
- add alertmanager config: grouping_key and dedupe 60s (omar)
- add rate_limit / repeat_interval for low-severity alerts (sre)
- dashboard: runtime to add model_variant latency and KV cache panels (kevin)
- runbook: auto-fallback routing and steps to confirm customer impact (kevin + support)
- status page blip and customer comms (lee)
kevin (runtime): will add dashboard panels to the runtime grafana: p50/p95/p99 by model_variant and KV cache hit ratio by host. ETA: today EOD.
omar (sre): PR for alert change: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4923 - includes rule changes and alertmanager grouping. rolling to canary at 02:45 UTC.
jessica (oncall): canary looks good, no new pages in 20m. scaled down the extra pods at 03:05 UTC. marking mitigation succeeded.
lee (support): updated status page and pinged top affected customers with note and link to incident postmortem once available.
omar (sre): postmortem items added. main root cause: model-variant long-tail latency + reduced KV cache hit rate on a subset of hosts. secondary: alerting too chatty and grouped at service level rather than by model_variant.
kevin (runtime): will implement auto-fallback and KV cache monitoring hooks for early detection. also will add a synthetic check that exercises slow tail scenarios.
jessica (oncall): closing thread for now. if anyone sees residual noise after the alert changes, ping me.
omar (sre): quick note for ops: consider an alert suppressor that correlates identical stack traces and groups them before paging; could throttle pages if the same fingerprint repeats within 60s.
kevin (runtime): also propose a small dashboard tile showing "active deduped alerts" count so SREs can see when grouping suppressed noise.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLEAR: 03:12 UTC - services recovered. incident duration ~1h. Postmortem link to follow.
jessica (oncall): thanks all. will file the post-incident alert-tuning RFC with proposed thresholds and dedupe defaults. cc @sre-team @runtime-team :thumbsup:
